explanation: The International Tennis Federation adopted yellow balls in 1972 because television viewers could follow them more easily. Wimbledon kept white balls until 1986.

claims.text: Yellow tennis balls were introduced because they are easier than white ones to see on colour television.
Yellow balls were not introduced to save money, to stand out on clay courts or to mark the Open Era.
The International Tennis Federation added yellow balls to its rules in 1972.
Wimbledon switched from white to yellow balls in 1986.
